import { Bubble, BubbleContent } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/bubble";
import { Message, MessageContent, MessageGroup } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/message";

const Demo = () => (
  <MessageGroup className="w-80">
    <Message>
      <MessageContent>
        <Bubble variant="muted">
          <BubbleContent>Hello, how can I help?</BubbleContent>
        </Bubble>
      </MessageContent>
    </Message>
    <Message align="end">
      <MessageContent>
        <Bubble>
          <BubbleContent>Please show me an example.</BubbleContent>
        </Bubble>
      </MessageContent>
    </Message>
  </MessageGroup>
);

export default Demo;
